page.title: Routing rules
page.description: Decide which traffic goes direct, through your proxy, or is blocked.
page.evaluatedTopBottom: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom.
page.notLiveYet: These rules are not live yet. The core reads them when the connection is next brought up.
page.emptyDescription: Everything follows the presets above and then your active profile.

dialog.title: Edit routing rule
dialog.description: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom. The first match wins.
dialog.error: Enter a domain, IP range, or hostname.
dialog.outboundError: Choose where this traffic should go.
dialog.kindDomainSuffix: Matches this domain and everything under it.
dialog.warningWildcard: Wildcards do not work here. Write the suffix on its own, as example.com.
dialog.warningUrl: Write the hostname on its own, without a scheme or a path.
dialog.warningNonAscii: Non-ASCII names are not converted. Enter the domain in its punycode form.
dialog.warningInvalidPrefix: The prefix length is out of range for this address.
dialog.warningInvalidDomain: This does not look like a domain, an address, or a range.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this routing rule?
deleteDialog.description: Traffic that matched it will follow the rules below it, or your active profile.
